dedupe_keys.name: world bank geocoded internet exchange points global ixp cities

description: This World Bank Data Catalog entry offers a list of internet exchange point (IXP) cities worldwide, taken from the Packet Clearing House and PeeringDB listings and geocoded with GeoNames so that each exchange city has coordinates. It is published as a single CSV file of geocoded IXP cities and as an ArcGIS feature service, and is tagged as infrastructure data for information and communication technologies; the catalogue also lists it in its Ukraine datasets collection. Coverage: global, at city or metropolitan granularity, with a country list starting from Afghanistan, Albania and Algeria. The CSV was last updated on 16 October 2020 and the metadata on 19 January 2023, and the page reports 2,317 views and 595 downloads. Format and access: CSV of about 188 KB and a vector feature service API, free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, public classification. Caveats: a one-off 2020 extract that is not refreshed, so exchanges opened or closed since then are missing; it holds city points only, without members, traffic or facilities. Simulation uses: quick global maps of interconnection hubs for hazard exposure screening and for linking countries to their nearest exchange in network models. Related records: the PCH IXP directory and PeeringDB are the live sources, and the CAIDA IXPs dataset adds facilities and members.
